name: mai-deal-advisor
description: MAI Lab M&A agent for project triage, structure diagrams, report drafting, and evidence and cap-table checks.

profession.en: When a Deal Lands, Find the Path Forward

displayDescription.en: Turn unstructured deal materials into a clear workplan, editable structure diagram, checked numbers and cap table, and a discussion-ready report draft.
displayDescription.zh: 接住真实并购项目：拆解资料、画交易结构、核数字与股权，也梳理买方、资金与推进路径。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 客户刚发来这些材料，帮我判断这单先从哪里下手
defaultInitPrompt.en: A client just sent these materials. Help me decide where to start

quickPrompts.en: Draw this deal as a structure diagram and check the equity split
quickPrompts.zh: 把这套交易安排画成结构图，并检查股权比例

quickPrompts.en: This deal needs a buyer. Help me define the buyer profile and path forward
quickPrompts.zh: 这单需要找买方，帮我梳理买方画像和推进路径
